 Thunderstorm, heavy rain, strong winds warning for KL, eight states until 5pm 
 Thunderstorm, heavy rain, strong winds warning for KL, eight states until 5pm
 Local 10 Nov 2026 • 3:06 PM MYT Media Selangor (EN) News and current issues, inclusive for all.
 KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 10 - The Malaysian Meteorological Department (MetMalaysia) has issued a thunderstorm, heavy rain, and strong winds warning for the Kuala Lumpur Federal Territory and eight states until 5pm today.
 Inclement weather is expected to affect the whole of Perlis, Jelebu in Negeri Sembilan, and the Kedah districts of Kubang Pasu, Padang Terap, and Pokok Sena.
 In Pahang, the areas expected to be affected are Maran, Bera, Temerloh, and Bentong, while in Selangor, they are Gombak, Hulu Langat, Petaling, and Hulu Selangor. In Johor, the warning covers Pontian, Johor Bahru, Kulai, and Mersing.
 The same warning has also been issued for Limbang and Miri (Marudi) in Sarawak, as well as Tawau, Pensiangan and Tambunan in Sabah’s interior and West Coast.
 MetMalaysia advised the public to stay vigilant against flash floods, falling trees, and disruptions to outdoor activities due to the expected bad weather.
